rules: Companions are optional. Decline is success. Never block a phase on an install.
Suggest at the moment of need. Do not dump the shelf at kickoff or in the first user-facing message.
Do not install, enroll, or publish unless the user asked.
After a companion run that matters, persist the outcome in .forgetrail/workflow_tracking.json and the matching progressive doc.
Do not mention the mapping file, spec paths, or MCP tool names in human-facing offers.

situations.trigger: The project needs a Markdown site (docs, changelog, writing, marketing) or a one-shot event page.

tools.name: FilePress
tools.offer: FilePress turns a Markdown folder into a static site. Cloudflare Pages with Wrangler is a free publish path.

situations.trigger: An interactive app still needs a marketing or docs site beside the product.

tools.name: FilePress
tools.offer: Keep the app on its own stack. Add a site/ folder with FilePress for docs and marketing, the same pattern forgetrail.dev uses.

situations.trigger: Registrar, DNS, git host, or production hosting is still open, and the user has not already named a provider.

tools.name: Cloudflare
tools.offer: Cloudflare is the default DNS path when no provider is already chosen. The free plan covers DNS, edge TLS, and Cloudflare Pages for a static deploy. A DigitalOcean droplet (or similar) remains a fine origin when the app needs a server.

situations.trigger: This machine already runs, or will run, two or more local apps, or bookmarks hit the wrong process after reboot.

tools.name: LocalSlip
tools.offer: LocalSlip keeps a named port claim so startup order does not move the app.

tools.name: LocalHelm
tools.offer: LocalHelm shows status across the repos you enroll. Inspection does not publish.

situations.trigger: Intake chose local Ollama for runtime or build-time generation.

tools.name: ollanet
tools.offer: ollanet finds and aliases Ollama hosts you choose. Keep setup-ollama and test-ollama as the in-repo health scripts.

situations.trigger: Ollama is in use and VRAM, context length, or GPU residency is the actual question.

tools.name: Finetuna
tools.offer: Finetuna measures a runtime profile (num_ctx, num_batch, num_gpu). It does not train weights.

situations.trigger: Phase 6 copy, README, landing, changelog, or a brand-copy edit pass.

tools.name: Smell Check
tools.offer: Smell Check reviews prose for wording that has not earned its place. It complements a brand-copy pass; it does not replace it.

tools.name: Misemphasis
tools.offer: Misemphasis finds the other reading a sentence already allows.

situations.trigger: Docs, README, or in-app journeys after repeated edits no longer meet.

tools.name: Detangler
tools.offer: Detangler reports broken references, competing sources of truth, and flows that no longer connect. Review does not silently edit.

situations.trigger: Pre-launch or wrap: check whether a newcomer can use what you are about to ship.

tools.name: Cold-eye
tools.offer: Cold-eye returns a readiness verdict and ranked gaps. It is not a security audit unless that was the chosen review.

situations.trigger: Hard-to-undo work: delete data, lock persistence, rewrite history, or lock a stack.

tools.name: TemperPass
tools.offer: TemperPass names consequential assumptions before you proceed.

situations.trigger: The failure is real and the cause is not yet earned.

tools.name: Gap Last
tools.offer: Gap Last separates observations, constraints, and remaining questions, then proposes hypotheses. A hypothesis is not the established cause. Log leftovers in gotchas[].

situations.trigger: A product, tool, MCP server, agent config, or skill is going public or being handed off.

tools.name: xFacts
tools.offer: xFacts labels (AppFacts and neighbors) are the house standard for shipped products. Write a label when the product is public or handed off. A validator checks shape, not truth.

situations.trigger: Unpushed local branches or tags the operator cannot afford to lose, or a rebase/rewrite is about to start.

tools.name: IngotVault
tools.offer: IngotVault mirrors covered local branches and tags to a drive you control. It never modifies origin. It does not replace commit discipline.

situations.trigger: The builder captures ideas by voice, or wants a local journal beside the repo trail.

tools.name: DictaWhisper
tools.offer: DictaWhisper is a local voice journal. Audio stays on the computer. It is a personal capture tool, not part of the app stack.

situations.trigger: A Genesis, plan, or long chat still lives only on a website and the user wants a local file.

tools.name: HaulOut
tools.offer: HaulOut exports the open thread to local Markdown or JSON. It is a Tampermonkey userscript, not a one-line install. It is not an account-wide archive.

situations.trigger: Phase 1 competitive or market briefing, or a handoff that must start from what is true now.

tools.name: EmberDossier
tools.offer: EmberDossier is a briefing format that starts with what is true now. The agent still does the research. as_of is a compile date, not a live feed.

situations.trigger: The product is a Node CLI that non-terminal operators must run.

tools.name: gui4cli
tools.offer: gui4cli opens a desktop form over an existing Commander or yargs script. First launch downloads the NW.js runtime.

situations.trigger: The product must edit an existing Google Doc, Sheet, or Slides file in place.

tools.name: DocuPuncture
tools.offer: DocuPuncture makes targeted Apps Script edits on the Google file you already have. Dry run first.
